verses.1: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.
verses.2: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.
verses.3: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
